name: Pitane
text: Pitane (Ancient Greek: Πιτάνη), near Çandarlı, Turkey, was an ancient Greek town of the ancient region of Aeolis, in Asia Minor. It was situated near the mouth of the river Evenus on the bay of Elaea. It was one of the eleven ancient Aeolian settlements and possessed considerable commercial advantages in having two harbours.

depictions.name: Pitana
depictions.text: Pitane (Laconia) Pitana was a village situated in Lakonia, Peloponnese, Greece. Along with Mesoa, Limnai and Kynosoura, it was one of the villages that formed the poleis Sparta. The Agiads, one of Sparta's royal families, originated from Pitana.
